name: YOLO mode exit signal mismatch causes infinite loop or premature exit
description: The FADE YOLO/ALL mode loop checks for exit signals STORY_DONE, ALL_COMPLETE, and BLOCKED, but the prompt.md template instructs Claude to output COMPLETE instead of ALL_COMPLETE when a PRD is finished. This causes the loop to fail to detect completion and display 'No exit signal detected'.

userStories.title: Align exit signals between fade script and prompt.md template
userStories.description: As a FADE user running YOLO mode, I want the exit signals to be consistent so the loop terminates correctly when work is complete
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md template uses ALL_COMPLETE (not COMPLETE) as the signal for PRD completion
fade script expects ALL_COMPLETE, STORY_DONE, and BLOCKED as valid signals
Signal definitions are documented in one canonical location
Both fade script and prompt.md reference the same signal names

userStories.title: Add signal reference comment in fade script
userStories.description: As a FADE maintainer, I want the valid exit signals documented inline so future changes don't create mismatches
acceptanceCriteria: Comment block in fade script lists all valid signals with their meanings
Comment references prompt.md as the source of truth for Claude's behavior
Signal meanings: STORY_DONE (one story complete), ALL_COMPLETE (PRD complete), BLOCKED (cannot proceed)
